meta.title: RestoLink — Menus, reinvented
meta.description: RestoLink turns a QR code into a fast, always up-to-date digital menu that guests open straight in their browser.

hero.title: Menus, reinvented.
hero.subtitle: Your guest scans a code and the menu is already open. You change a price and it is live everywhere in seconds.

experience.title: Three seconds from table to menu.
experience.subtitle: No app store, no waiting for a printed card — just a browser your guest already has open.

step1.title: Scans the QR code
step1.body: The camera is enough. The menu opens in the browser, with no app to install and nothing to sign up for.

step2.title: Browses and filters
step2.body: Photos, descriptions and allergens in one place. Whoever avoids gluten hides everything containing it with a single tap.

step3.title: Orders and pays
step3.body: The order lands straight on the kitchen console, and the bill is settled without waiting for anyone to bring the terminal.

b1.title: Full control
b1.body: Drag and drop to reorder, toggle a dish's availability with one click. No developer, no waiting.
b1.caption: Menu builder · 4:3

b2.title: Orders Console
b2.body: A loud alert in the kitchen and an order status the whole shift can see at a glance.
b2.caption: Orders console · 4:3

b3.title: Google Maps & reviews
b3.body: A happy guest lands on your listing before they get up from the table.
b3.caption: Listing and reviews · 4:3

b4.title: Accessibility (WCAG)
b4.body: Screen readers, contrast computed from background luminance, and a menu in two languages.
b4.caption: Accessibility settings · 4:3

pricing.title: Simple and predictable.
pricing.subtitle: One rate, no commission on orders and no setup fee.

start.name: Start
start.desc: Everything a single venue needs to get going.

pro.name: Pro
pro.desc: For venues that also take orders through the menu.

contact.title: Let's talk.
contact.subtitle: Tell us about your venue and we will show you what the menu would look like.
contact.name: Full name
contact.note: We usually reply the same business day.

footer.tagline: Digital menus for restaurants, cafés and bars. A QR code instead of a printed card.
